pay_components_amount_ck.name: pay_components_amount_ck
pay_components_amount_ck.value:
("pay_components"."amount_type" IN ('percent_basic', 'percent_gross') AND "pay_components"."rate" IS NOT NULL AND "pay_components"."rate" > 0 AND "pay_components"."rate" <= 100 AND "pay_components"."amount_rwf" IS NULL)
        OR ("pay_components"."amount_type" NOT IN ('percent_basic', 'percent_gross') AND "pay_components"."amount_rwf" IS NOT NULL AND "pay_components"."amount_rwf" > 0 AND "pay_components"."rate" IS NULL)

pay_components_condition_ck.name: pay_components_condition_ck
pay_components_condition_ck.value: ("pay_components"."condition_field" IS NULL) = ("pay_components"."condition_op" IS NULL) AND ("pay_components"."condition_field" IS NULL) = ("pay_components"."condition_value" IS NULL)

assistant_conversations_has_holder.name: assistant_conversations_has_holder
assistant_conversations_has_holder.value: "assistant_conversations"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "assistant_conversations"."anon_token_hash" IS NOT NULL

assistant_turns_counts_nonnegative.name: assistant_turns_counts_nonnegative
assistant_turns_counts_nonnegative.value: "assistant_turns"."model_calls" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."model_tool_calls" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."input_tokens" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."output_tokens" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."cache_read_tokens" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."cache_write_tokens" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."estimated_cost_micro_usd" >= 0 AND "assistant_turns"."duration_ms" >= 0

found_items_disposal_two_people_ck.name: found_items_disposal_two_people_ck
found_items_disposal_two_people_ck.value: "found_items"."disposal_approved_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "found_items"."disposal_approved_by_user_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "found_items"."disposal_proposed_by_user_id"

landlord_profiles_signatory_id_shape.name: landlord_profiles_signatory_id_shape
landlord_profiles_signatory_id_shape.value:
("landlord_profiles"."signatory_id_kind" IS NULL AND "landlord_profiles"."signatory_id_number" IS NULL)
        OR ("landlord_profiles"."signatory_id_kind" = 'national_id' AND "landlord_profiles"."signatory_id_number" ~ '^[0-9]{16}$')
        OR ("landlord_profiles"."signatory_id_kind" = 'passport' AND "landlord_profiles"."signatory_id_number" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{5,20}$')

landlord_profiles_contact_shape.name: landlord_profiles_contact_shape
landlord_profiles_contact_shape.value:
("landlord_profiles"."contact_email" IS NULL OR "landlord_profiles"."contact_email" = lower("landlord_profiles"."contact_email"))
        AND ("landlord_profiles"."contact_phone" IS NULL OR "landlord_profiles"."contact_phone" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$')

lease_applications_broker_shape.name: lease_applications_broker_shape
lease_applications_broker_shape.value: "lease_applications"."broker_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("lease_applications"."broker_fee_rwf" IS NULL AND "lease_applications"."broker_terms" IS NULL)

waitlist_owner_complete.name: waitlist_owner_complete
waitlist_owner_complete.value:
("waitlist_signups"."audience" <> 'owner') OR (
        "waitlist_signups"."phone" IS NOT NULL
        AND "waitlist_signups"."business_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "waitlist_signups"."district_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "waitlist_signups"."property_type" IS NOT NULL
        AND "waitlist_signups"."size_band" IS NOT NULL
      )
